title: Multi-creator launch video for the device

segments.text: Got a bit of an idea that's interesting for a video, which is to sell the Ivy product itself. It's to get several creators and have them talking to the device with the hook being that the ideas are connected into something like Mr. Beast's
viral video that I was watching the other day on YouTube, if you can find it.

The video should be pretty short. I'm thinking that we have it in different hands and different people, and that the goal of the video is to make the product, then the AI, and then the output, and then a video all really seamless, all really fun.

And I think fun is the is the goal, is to make the UI and the AI really personable and really, I guess, optimistic around great ideas and talkative, and we can kind of show the visuals of that rather than lots of fun.
Like to have your thoughts on it and put together some ideas and storyboards and even some demo concepts.

cards.title: Several creators talking to the device
cards.gist: A video selling the product itself by getting several creators to talk to the device, with the hook being that their ideas get connected together.
cards.frame_brief: several different hands each holding a small handheld device in a row

cards.title: Keep it short, hands to output
cards.gist: The video should be short, passing the device between different hands and people, moving seamlessly from product to AI to output to finished video.
cards.frame_brief: a small handheld device passing from one hand to another, with a finished video frame beside it

loose_ends.text: Find the Mr. Beast viral video she was watching the other day on YouTube
